$comment: Datamine-only achievements: in the game data, but players never see them, as {"id": "why"}. The build treats them like the game's own disused ones: kept in data/, hidden and not counted. Only list achievements the game doesn't show; a real one stays, even if nobody has completed it yet. The build compares the dump with stardb.gg and warns about live achievements stardb doesn't list (datamine-only?) and about ids here that stardb lists (remove those).
84517: Only in the datamine: stardb.gg doesn't list it (Instant Karma)
